title: Minimum DNF size
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, define its DNF size to be the infimum in $ br$-valued notation of the natural numbers $s$ for which $f$ has a DNF of size at most $s$; since this is an infimum in $ br$ over a subset of $ br$, it is the greatest lower bound of those admissible sizes.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
caveat: The predicate HasDNFSizeLE, which determines admissible sizes, is not defined in the supplied snippet.
